resources.string: Unknown callers: the ringer is silenced and you are notified
Unknown callers: the ringer is silenced
What Sparta can and cannot do on this phone
Silence the ringer or reject a call from an unknown or blocked number.
Show you who called (the number is masked) and what Sparta decided.
Keep block and trust lists on this phone, working without a connection.
Answer a phone call on this phone, or speak to the caller. Android does not allow apps to do this.
Hear or record call audio. Sparta never records calls.
Run an AI conversation on a normal call. That only happens when the call is forwarded to your Sparta telephony number, which is a backend capability.
Without notifications Sparta cannot tell you when a call needs you or when it silences a caller.
